summary: Completed comprehensive testing of International Attendance RBAC overhaul and data save bug fix. All 9 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed.

rbac_super_admin_dropdown.details: Super Admin (PB-MGT) sees center dropdown with ONLY international centers (PB-PERTH). India centers (PB-HSR, PB-TH, etc.) are correctly excluded from dropdown.

rbac_perth_manager_fixed_badge.details: Perth Manager sees fixed badge 'PB-PERTH' with center name, NO dropdown. Can access their own center's attendance data.

rbac_india_manager_access_denied.details: India Manager (PB-HSR) sees 'Access Restricted' message with warning icon. Message: 'International Attendance is not available for India centers'. No attendance table visible.

backend_403_for_india_centers.details: POST /api/international-attendance/centers with India center token returns 403 with message about India centers not having access.

backend_show_dropdown_true_for_admin.details: POST /api/international-attendance/centers with Super Admin token returns show_dropdown=true and ONLY non-India centers.

backend_show_dropdown_false_for_perth.details: POST /api/international-attendance/centers with Perth manager token returns show_dropdown=false and only PB-PERTH.

data_save_bug_fix.details: Saved different hours for Employee A (8hrs) and Employee B (4hrs). Fetched week-data and verified each employee has DIFFERENT hours. Bug fix confirmed working.

centers_management_is_india_toggle.details: 'Is India Center?' toggle visible in both Add and Edit dialogs. PB-PERTH shows 'Intl' badge in centers list (is_india_center=false).

sidebar_international_menu_visibility.details: International Attendance menu item visible for Super Admin and Perth Manager. NOT visible for India Manager (PB-HSR).

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing PB-PERTH employees including ASHA, Amit Kumar, MANISH (employees without employee_id field - system uses MongoDB _id as fallback).
context_for_next_testing_agent: International Attendance RBAC overhaul is fully working. Key points: 1) is_india_center field on centers collection controls access, 2) Super Admin sees dropdown with only international centers, 3) International center managers see fixed badge (no dropdown), 4) India center managers get Access Restricted screen and 403 from API, 5) Data save bug fixed - employees without employee_id use MongoDB _id as fallback, ensuring unique identification. WhatsApp integration remains MOCKED.
